rest.name: Unassigned
rest.description: Leave this adult free. Unused work does not carry over.

plant.name: Sow the field
plant.description: Plant this year’s crop. Harvest will need two adults in autumn.

tend.name: Tend the crop
tend.description: Keep weeds down. Add 8 food to the autumn harvest.

harvest.name: Bring in the harvest
harvest.description: Assign two adults to gather the entire crop.

paid.name: Work for wages
paid.description: A spell of work at the village mill earns a little money.

repair.name: Mend the house
repair.description: Replace tired thatch and patch the walls before the cold.

help.name: Help the neighbour
help.description: Lend a hand to Vasile. Build trust and share a meal.

supplies.name: Buy provisions
supplies.description: Bring home a modest, dependable supply of grain.

petru.name: Petru
petru.line: “A place here should mean a say here.”

spring-ox.title: A favour in the furrows
spring-ox.text: Vasile rests a hand on the gate. “That field is too much for a spade alone. Take my ox for the sowing. Come harvest, you can send someone to help me.” Behind him, the earth is finally beginning to soften.

choices.label: Accept his kindness
choices.detail: +10 potential harvest · owe one adult in autumn

memory.title: A promise to Vasile
memory.detail: One adult owed to the neighbour in autumn, in return for his ox this spring.

choices.label: Pay for the ox
choices.detail: −5 money · +10 potential harvest · no obligation

memory.title: An honest exchange
memory.detail: You paid to use Vasile’s ox for the spring work. Your autumn labour remains your own.

choices.label: Work with what we have
choices.detail: No cost or promise · a smaller potential harvest

memory.title: Our own hands
memory.detail: You chose to plant without the ox, keeping your money and independence.

spring-table.title: The first meal together
spring-table.text: Ana lays out the last of the old linen. “The house is ours now, but the days should be ours too. We need to speak of what each of us hopes to keep.” Vasile has left a small sack of grain by the door.

choices.label: Accept the grain with thanks
choices.detail: +3 food · remember Vasile’s kindness

memory.title: Bread at our table
memory.detail: Vasile shared grain in your first spring. Ana remembers the warmth of that evening.

choices.label: Keep our own table
choices.detail: No resource change · preserve your independence

memory.title: A quiet beginning
memory.detail: You made your first meal from your own stores. Ana asked that decisions be shared.

summer-brother.title: A place of his own
summer-brother.text: Petru stops sharpening the sickle. “Father’s share came to both of us. I work these strips beside you. What part of the stores can I call my own?” He is not asking to leave. He wants a say in what the household keeps and spends.

choices.label: Promise him a fair share
choices.detail: −3 money for his own needs · Petru contributes 2 food in autumn

memory.title: A brother, with a share
memory.detail: You set aside money for Petru’s own needs and recognised his place in household decisions. He will add provisions at harvest.

choices.label: Hear him, but keep the stores together
choices.detail: No cost · the inheritance remains unresolved

memory.title: An unfinished conversation
memory.detail: You listened to Petru, but left his share undecided. He stayed, with questions.

summer-tended.title: What careful hands can do
summer-tended.text: The rows stand straight and green. Ana brushes a seed head with her fingertips. “We did right by this patch of earth.” There is no harvest yet, but for the first time the field looks like a promise you can keep.

choices.label: Let the crop ripen
choices.detail: The tending bonus is already included in your autumn crop

memory.title: A well-tended field
memory.detail: You gave the crop the summer attention it needed. The larger harvest is ready for autumn.

summer-dry.title: A field left waiting
summer-dry.text: There was other work to do, and weeds found their way between the rows. Ana says nothing for a while. “We can still gather what grows. Let us be honest about how much that will be.”

choices.label: Take stock and carry on
choices.detail: No additional loss · the crop has no tending bonus

memory.title: Other work came first
memory.detail: Summer labour went elsewhere. The field’s potential remains smaller.

autumn-promise.title: The hand you promised
autumn-promise.text: Vasile comes before sunrise. “My grain is ready. Yours too, by the look of it.” He does not mention the ox. He does not have to. Keeping your word will leave just two adults to bring your own harvest home.

choices.label: Send Petru to help him
choices.detail: Reserve Petru’s one assignment · keep the promise

memory.title: A promise kept
memory.detail: Petru helped Vasile at harvest. Your household had two adults left for its own work.

choices.label: Keep everyone at home
choices.detail: All three adults available · Vasile will refuse winter assistance

memory.title: A promise broken
memory.detail: You kept the autumn worker you had promised. Vasile will remember when winter comes.

autumn-free.title: Before the first frost
autumn-free.text: Mist sits low over the field. There is grain to gather, a house to prepare, and an old disagreement waiting at the village. No worker is promised elsewhere. How you spend these days is yours to decide.

choices.label: Gather the household
choices.detail: Three adults available · harvest needs two assignments

autumn-dispute.title: Where the furrow ends
autumn-dispute.text: Dumitru has spoken with the cousin who shares your inherited land. The two households remember the boundary differently. “Let us walk it together, with neighbours to hear the agreement.” You can meet the expense now, or leave the conversation until spring.

choices.label: Settle the disagreement
choices.detail: −4 money · arrange a witnessed boundary agreement

memory.title: A boundary settled
memory.detail: Dumitru brought the families and neighbours together. You agreed where your working strips meet. Next spring begins with one less argument.

choices.label: Leave it until spring
choices.detail: No cost · the dispute remains part of your ending

memory.title: The disputed boundary
memory.detail: You kept your money. The inheritance disagreement will still need an answer next spring.

winter-friend.title: A door that opens
winter-friend.text: Smoke rises from Vasile’s chimney. He opens the door before you knock. “Cold year,” he says, making room by the fire. The way you treated him in the warmer months has not been forgotten.

choices.label: Ask for a little help
choices.detail: +6 food · accept a neighbour’s support

memory.title: No winter alone
memory.detail: Vasile shared winter provisions. The relationship you kept became food on your table.

choices.label: Visit, but rely on our stores
choices.detail: No resource change · keep the friendship

memory.title: A friendly fire
memory.detail: You shared a conversation with Vasile, then returned to your own provisions.

winter-isolation.title: The weight of a broken word
winter-isolation.text: Vasile meets you at the gate. “In autumn I needed a hand. You had given your word.” His voice is quiet. There is no grain offered today, only the space between what was promised and what was done.

choices.label: Return home and make do
choices.detail: No winter assistance · your household can still work and buy supplies

memory.title: A closed door
memory.detail: Vasile refused winter help because the autumn promise was broken.

winter-hearth.title: A home worth keeping
winter-hearth.text: The roof holds. In the lamplight, Petru mends a handle while Ana sets three bowls on the table. “It was never only the house,” she says. Outside, beneath the snow, the field waits for another spring.

choices.label: Sit together by the fire
choices.detail: Resolve winter consumption and see what the year has meant

memory.title: Three bowls by the fire
memory.detail: You ended the year together, remembering the work and the words that brought you here.

choices.label: Make a small celebration
choices.detail: −2 food before winter consumption · a warm family memory

memory.title: A meal to remember
memory.detail: You used a little extra food to celebrate a year together. Ana and Petru remember it.

winter-cold.title: Close around the embers
winter-cold.text: The wind has found the seams in the old roof. You draw the chairs close to the fire. Ana passes Petru a blanket. “Whatever the spring brings, we will speak of it together.” For now, there is the work of staying warm.

choices.label: Share the warmth we have
choices.detail: Cold shelter adds extra food consumption · resolve the year

memory.title: Close around the embers
memory.detail: The damaged house made winter harder. Your family stayed close around the remaining warmth.
